decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster is integral to the firm's coolant management systems and supports high-pressure machining trends, so withdrawal is unlikely.
The cleaning centrifuge strengthens the filtration and sustainability offer and complements existing coolant systems.
The nozzle line is a low-cost accessory range that cross-sells with pumps and boosters, though individual models could be consolidated.
Scraper belt chip conveyors are a staple of the firm's core conveying business for metalworking customers.
Hinged belt chip conveyors are among the most common conveyor types and remain central to the established offer.
